models.name: hrm_platform_organizations
models.description:
Multi-tenancy root entity containing organization identity, branding, and operational settings.

This table represents the foundational business entity for the HRM platform's multi-tenancy architecture. Each organization operates independently with its own employees, projects, departments, and data. Organization settings include currency preferences, timezone configuration, and fiscal period definitions that affect all downstream business operations.

Key relationships:
- All employee records ({@link hrm_platform_employees}) belong to an organization
- All projects ({@link hrm_platform_projects}) belong to an organization
- All departments ({@link hrm_platform_departments}) belong to an organization
- All roles ({@link hrm_platform_roles}) belong to an organization
- All activity logs ({@link hrm_platform_activity_logs}) reference an organization context

Organization deletion cascades to all dependent entities while preserving the owner's user account.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Organization name displayed to users and used in branding.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional organization description providing additional context about the organization.

plainFields.name: logo_url
plainFields.description: URL to organization logo image for branding purposes.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Default currency code for the organization (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW). Used for contract pay rates and financial reporting.

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: Organization timezone identifier (e.g., Asia/Seoul, America/New_York). Affects timesheet periods, timer calculations, and report aggregations.

plainFields.name: fiscal_start_month
plainFields.description: Fiscal year start month (1-12). January is 1, December is 12. Used for financial reporting and budget tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was soft deleted. Null indicates active organization.

models.name: hrm_platform_organization_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time snapshots of organization settings for audit trail and change history tracking.

Captures historical states of organization configurations including branding (name, description, logo), operational settings (currency, timezone), and fiscal period configuration. Each snapshot represents the complete organization state at a specific moment, enabling compliance tracking, change auditing, and historical reconstruction.

Snapshots are created automatically when organization settings are modified, forming an immutable append-only audit trail. Unlike the main hrm_platform_organizations table which reflects current state, snapshots preserve all historical versions for regulatory compliance and change analysis.

Referenced by {@link hrm_platform_organizations} for organization context.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Target organization's {@link hrm_platform_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Organization name at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Organization description at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: logo_url
plainFields.description: Organization logo image URL at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Organization currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW) at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: Organization timezone at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: fiscal_start_month
plainFields.description: Fiscal year start month (1-12) at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp.

models.name: hrm_platform_contracts
models.description:
Employment contracts with historical tracking, allowing multiple contracts per employee with only one active at a time. Each contract records start date, end date, pay rate, pay period, working hours per week, and optional notes. Past contracts are immutable historical records used for compliance and employment history verification.

Each employee can have multiple contracts over time, but only one contract can be active at any given time (indicated by null end_date). Creating a new contract automatically ends the previous active contract by setting its end date. Employees can view their own contracts, while users with employee:view permission can view any employee's contracts within their organization.

Related to {@link hrm_platform_employees} through employee reference.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_employee_id

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Contract end date. Null value indicates an ongoing contract with no specified end date.

plainFields.name: pay_rate
plainFields.description: Pay rate amount for the contract. Required numeric value representing compensation rate.

plainFields.name: pay_period
plainFields.description: Pay period type for compensation calculation. Valid values: hourly, daily, weekly, monthly.

plainFields.name: working_hours_per_week
plainFields.description: Number of working hours per week as defined in the contract. Required for full-time and part-time employees.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional contract notes or additional information about employment terms.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit trail.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp for tracking modifications.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for archival purposes. Null indicates active record.

models.name: hrm_platform_timelogs
models.description:
Individual time entries recording work duration with date, project, task, and billable status. Each timelog represents a single time tracking entry created by an employee for their work activities. Timelogs can be included in timesheets for weekly aggregation and approval workflows.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to one {@link hrm_platform_employees} (the employee who logged the time)
- Belongs to one {@link hrm_platform_projects} (the project worked on)
- Optionally belongs to one {@link hrm_platform_tasks} (the specific task within the project)

Business rules:
- Employees can only create timelogs for themselves
- Timelogs can be edited or deleted only if not part of an approved timesheet
- Billable flag indicates whether the time is chargeable to the client

plainFields.name: billable

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: hrm_platform_timesheets
models.description: Weekly timesheet aggregations with approval workflow and calculated total hours. Each timesheet represents a week (Monday to Sunday) for a specific employee and tracks time entry submissions through draft, submitted, approved, and rejected states. Timesheets aggregate individual timelogs from {@link hrm_platform_timelogs} and manage the approval workflow where managers can approve or reject submitted timesheets. When rejected, timesheets return to draft status for employee modification and resubmission. Approved timesheets lock all included timelogs to prevent further edits.

foreignFields.description: Belonged employee's {@link hrm_platform_employees.id}. Each employee can have at most one active timer (stopped_at is null).

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Tracked project's {@link hrm_platform_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional tracked task's {@link hrm_platform_tasks.id}. Must belong to the selected project.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: When the timer started tracking work duration.

plainFields.name: stopped_at
plainFields.description: When the timer was stopped. Null means timer is still running. Stopping creates a timelog with calculated duration.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the work being tracked.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit trail.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp for audit trail.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for data preservation and recovery.

models.name: hrm_platform_roles
models.description: Role definitions per organization including built-in (Owner, Manager, Employee) and custom roles. Built-in roles cannot be deleted, while custom roles can be removed only when no employees are assigned. Each employee in an organization is assigned exactly one role via the hrm_platform_employees table.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization's {@link hrm_platform_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique role code within organization for programmatic reference.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Role display name shown to users.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional role description explaining permissions and purpose.

plainFields.name: is_builtin
plainFields.description: Whether this is a built-in system role (Owner, Manager, Employee) that cannot be deleted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for custom roles only. Built-in roles are never deleted.

models.name: hrm_platform_role_permissions
models.description: Permission assignments mapping roles to available permissions like org:manage, employee:manage, project:view. This junction table implements the many-to-many relationship between roles and permissions, allowing roles to have multiple permissions and permissions to be assigned to multiple roles.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_role_id
foreignFields.description: Target role's {@link hrm_platform_roles.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_platform_permission_id
foreignFields.description: Target permission's {@link hrm_platform_permissions.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for audit trail.

models.name: hrm_platform_permissions
models.description: Available permission definitions that can be assigned to roles, including org:manage, employee:manage, project:view, time:approve, and other access control rights. This is a reference table containing predefined permissions that roles can be granted. Permissions support soft deletion for audit trail and recovery purposes.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique permission code identifier (e.g., 'org:manage', 'employee:view', 'time:approve'). Used as the reference key in role_permissions table.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the permission for UI display.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description explaining what this permission allows users to do.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Permission category grouping (e.g., 'org', 'employee', 'project', 'time', 'report') for organizational purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission definition was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission definition was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission definition was soft deleted. Null indicates active permission.

models.name: hrm_platform_activity_logs
models.description: Immutable audit trail records tracking all significant organizational actions for compliance, debugging, and oversight. Logs employee management events (invited, deactivated, reactivated), contract changes (created, edited), project lifecycle events (created, archived, completed, deleted), task status transitions, timesheet workflow actions (submitted, approved, rejected), and role assignments. Each record captures the actor user, action type, target entity type and ID, and contextual details. Users with org:manage permission can view the full activity log with filtering by action type, user, and date range. Supports pagination for efficient browsing of historical organizational events.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Target organization's {@link hrm_platform_organizations.id}. All activity logs are scoped to an organization for multi-tenancy isolation.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Actor member's {@link hrm_platform_members.id} who performed the action. May reference a member who was later deactivated.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of action performed. Examples: employee:invited, employee:deactivated, employee:reactivated, contract:created, contract:edited, project:created, project:archived, project:completed, project:deleted, task:status_changed, timesheet:submitted, timesheet:approved, timesheet:rejected, role:assigned, role:changed.

plainFields.name: target_entity
plainFields.description: Type of target entity affected by the action. Examples: employee, contract, department, project, task, timesheet, role.

plainFields.name: target_id
plainFields.description: Target entity's ID. Nullable for actions without a specific entity target (e.g., system events).

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Additional contextual information about the action in JSON format. Contains action-specific data like old/new values, rejection reasons, or metadata.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the action occurred. Automatically set on record creation.
